{{Quote|Nasty fight out here. Can't tell friend from enemy half the time. Seps just take off their uniforms and blend into the villages.|Jaynes, on the war on Ord Mantell|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''Jaynes''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as a [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] in the [[Republic Army]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Around the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3646 BBY]], he was stationed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]], where he served at [[Fort Garnik]] on the island of [[Avilatan]] during the [[Separatist War]] fought between the Republic and a group of [[Mantellian Separatist Movement|Separatists]]. While at the fort, he directed new arrivals to one of the base's combat instructors, [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Forris]]. Nearly [[3643 BBY|three years after]] his arrival on Ord Mantell, Jaynes was still serving on Ord Mantell and was stationed at [[Fortress/Legends|Fort]] Garnik, where he met a [[Meteor (Havoc Squad)|new recruit]] of [[Havoc Squad]], a well-known elite [[Squad/Legends|squad]] of Republic [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Don't think I'd be here if it wasn't for the instructors at the FG.|Jaynes, when asked about his time spent on Ord Mantell|<ref name="TOR" />}}
[[File:SergeantJaynes-TOR.png||thumb|left|90px|Sergeant Jaynes]]
A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]], Jaynes was a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] who served in the [[Republic Army]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], a period of unrest between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. During the war,<ref name="TOR" /> around the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3646 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TOR_dates|1}} By extension, this places the arrival of Jaynes on Ord Mantell three years earlier in [[3646 BBY]].</ref> he was stationed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] and spent some [[Time/Legends|time]] at [[Fort Garnik]], the main Republic base on the island of [[Avilatan]]. While at Fort Garnik, Jaynes and the other Republic [[Troop/Legends|troops]] stationed there fought in<ref name="TOR" /> the [[Separatist War]]<ref name="War">{{TORcite|type=message|Date night|Doc}} identfied the war as the "Separatist War."</ref> against a group of [[Mantellian Separatist Movement|Separatists]] attempting to take control of Ord Mantell. While fighting on Ord Mantell, Jaynes found that the Separatists could easily hide themselves in the planet's civilian population by replacing their uniforms with civilian clothes, leading to situations where Jaynes could not tell which people were allies and which were enemies. While on the planet, Jaynes received training from [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Forris]] and other instructors at a [[Unidentified Fort Garnik combat instructor academy|combat instructor academy]] located in the fort, which Jaynes credited as saving him during combat situations.<ref name="TOR" /> By the year [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> Jaynes had been stationed on Ord Mantell for nearly three years and was a [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]]. At the time, he was stationed near one of the entrances to the fort where he directed new soldiers to Forris for combat instruction.<ref name="TOR" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1}}
While he was stationed at the entrance to the fort, Jaynes encountered a [[Meteor (Havoc Squad)|new recruit]] of [[Havoc Squad]], a well-known elite [[Squad/Legends|squad]] in the Republic Military. When approached by the recruit, Jaynes expressed his pleasure of seeing someone from Havoc Squad and suggested that the recruit go to Forris for combat instruction.<ref name="TOR" />
{{Endgame}}

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Sergeant. Good to see Havoc Squad colors in the field!|Sergeant Jaynes, speaking to Havoc Squad's new recruit|<ref name="TOR" />}}
Jaynes had [[Color/Legends|black]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]], brown [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], and fair skin. He viewed the war on Ord Mantell as an unpleasant situation, though he saw his position at Fort Garnik as one of the better assignments on the world, due to its excellent training instructors. He attributed his survival during the war to the instructors at Fort Garnik, including Lieutenant Forris, whom he would point out to new military arrivals.<ref name="TOR" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1}}
Jaynes had respect for Havoc Squad and was pleased when he saw one of their members in the field at Fort Garnik.<ref name="TOR" />
{{Endgame}}

==Equipment==
While serving at Fort Garnik, Sergeant Jaynes wore a suit of the Republic Army's standard [[Armor/Legends|armor]] with blue markings. He also carried a [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Sergeant Jaynes first appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[2011]] [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|MMORPG]] produced by [[BioWare]]. He is located in Fort Garnik, the central location for beginning Republic characters starting on the planet Ord Mantell. In the game, Jaynes is featured in the Trooper quest "Best of the Best," in which he sends trooper characters to their first Skill Trainer. While the player is not required to talk to Jaynes,<ref name="TOR" /> this article is written with the assumption of 100% game completion.
